what: Bruker makes scientific instruments: mass spectrometers, nuclear magnetic resonance systems, X-ray analysers and microscopes used in research laboratories, and spatial biology instruments.
customers: Academic laboratories, pharmaceutical research, industrial quality control and clinical microbiology labs.
money: nuclear magnetic resonance and preclinical imaging
mass spectrometry, microbiology and molecular diagnostics
moat: Instruments like high-field NMR magnets have almost no alternative supplier, and once installed they anchor a laboratory's methods for twenty years.
risks: A $167M net loss after acquisition write-downs

$2.0B of debt against $299M of cash after an acquisition programme
opportunities: $245M of free cash flow and analysts see about 9% upside

watch: Organic order growth and whether academic instrument budgets recover.
